methodology.zip_crc: zipfile.testzip() on both full archives; PASS
methodology.netcdf: HDF5 variables read in native chunks/small row blocks. Numeric fields scanned fully for _FillValue/missing_value/NaN. The single 12,990,436-byte CDF2 cicecap.nc member was read into memory to count its one field; no archive copy was written.
methodology.grib: 609 messages processed one at a time with ecCodes; header lengths, message boundaries, edition and 7777 end markers checked.

product_context.name: ERA5-Land hourly data from 1950 to present
product_context.product_type: ERA5-Land reanalysis/model estimates, not direct local observations (product identity; values were not compared to station observations).
product_context.missing_request_metadata: Exact original CDS request selections were unavailable; the MHT history was not independently inspected.

spatial_assessment.qualification: Grid extent includes Kerala, but no state polygon or per-cell Kerala-only mask was applied. Global missing fractions are not Kerala-specific.

dataset_decisions.reason: The main data_0.nc has only two instants, 2024-01-03 03:00 and 06:00 UTC. Static ancillary fields do not extend the weather time series. It cannot support historical or seasonal weather features.

Fifty variables have only 12 timestamps each on four days between 2011-01-11 and 2011-01-29, with observed gaps of 2, 7, 15, 63 and 327 hours. Nine singleton ancillary records do not make a continuous series. Two ancillary GRIB1 members also have internal message-length discrepancies.

request_1.format: NetCDF-4/HDF5 plus one NetCDF classic 64-bit-offset member

tvh_tvl_assessment.7777_marker: present at actual member end; absent at declared header-length boundary
tvh_tvl_assessment.ecCodes: ecCodes accepted and parsed each complete member when supplied the actual member bytes.
tvh_tvl_assessment.classification: Genuine internal GRIB1 length-field inconsistency; not explained by trailing padding or concatenated GRIB messages. The cause is uncertain and the members should not be relied on until the publisher confirms or corrected files are obtained.

grib_integrity_audit.ordinary_padding_assessment: clake.grib, lsm.grib and slt.grib each have 44 zero bytes after a valid 7777 message end marker. This is trailing zero padding, distinct from tvh/tvl.

model_suitability.historical_weather_features: Not supported by either current archive. The first is a two-instant sample; the second is 12 irregular instants per variable on four dates. Request continuous date coverage before feature construction.
model_suitability.rainfall_features: tp is present in both. NetCDF tp is marked GRIB_stepType=accum; GRIB tp stepType is accum with step ranges 12-13, 14-15 and 21-22. Sparse intervals and accumulated semantics prevent reliable daily/seasonal totals from these files.
model_suitability.temperature_features: t2m (NetCDF) and 2t (GRIB) are present; NetCDF is instant and GRIB stepType is instant. Sparse dates make them unsuitable as historical training features.
model_suitability.soil_features: swvl1-swvl4 and stl1-stl4 are soil-water/temperature estimates, not soil pH, texture, nutrients or fertility measurements. Sparse dates do not support training. Soil-type codes require a verified code-table mapping.
model_suitability.kerala_crop_recommendation: Not sufficient. The files provide potential weather covariates but no crop recommendation labels, crop yield outcomes, management data or verified Kerala-specific feature/target coverage.
model_suitability.reanalysis_vs_observations: ERA5-Land is a reanalysis product; do not describe the grid values as direct observations. No station comparison was performed.

next_steps: Keep both archives unchanged and do not train on them.
Specify a Kerala-focused spatial subset and an uninterrupted historical period appropriate to the feature; obtain a targeted ERA5-Land request only after approval.
Require timestamp completeness and verify precipitation accumulation windows before deriving rainfall totals.
Validate per-cell land coverage against an authoritative Kerala boundary in a later approved QA/preprocessing stage.
Use crop/yield labels and verified soil/agronomic sources for crop-recommendation modelling; weather alone is insufficient.
Obtain Copernicus confirmation or corrected tvh.grib and tvl.grib members before using those ancillary fields.
